latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of pr-specialist, providing expert PR and media relations guidance for earned media, press coverage, and reputation building.
- Offers frameworks for media outreach, press kit creation, embargo strategy, crisis communication, thought leadership, analyst relations, award submissions, and PR measurement.
- Includes structured methodologies such as the Newsworthiness Test, PR Funnel, Media Tier Framework, Pitch Response Matrix, and principles for effective journalist relationship building.
- Highlights best practices and anti-patterns to improve PR outcomes and reputation management.
